resolved.title: JavaScript 数组
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]JavaScript Arrays [/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Arrays [/b]store multiple values in a single variable. 

To store three course names, you need three variables.[code format="js" ]var course1 ="HTML"; 
var course2 ="CSS"; 
var course3 ="JS"; [/code]
But what if you had 500 courses? The solution is an [b]array[/b].[code format="js" ]var courses = [b]new Array[/b]("HTML", "CSS", "JS"); [/code]
[note]This syntax declares an array named [b]courses[/b], which stores three values, or elements.[/note]

resolved.title: 数组的访问
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Accessing an Array[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You refer to an array element by referring to the [b]index number[/b] written in [b]square brackets[/b].
This statement accesses the value of the first element in [b]courses [/b]and changes the value of the second element. [code format="js" ]var courses = new Array("HTML", "CSS", "JS"); 
var course = courses[b][0][/b]; // HTML
courses[b][1][/b] = "C++"; //Changes the second element [/code]
[note][0] is the first element in an array. [1] is the second. Array indexes start with [b]0[/b].[/note]

content.text:
通过方括号中的 **索引号** 来指代一个数组元素。
这个语句访问了 **courses** 中第一个元素的值，并改变了第二个元素的值。
content.text_html:

resolved.title: 数组的访问

content.text: 试图访问数组外的索引，返回值为 **undefined**。
content.text_html:
Attempting to access an index outside of the array, returns the value undefined.

试图访问数组外的索引，返回值为未定义。

content.js_code:
var courses = new Array("HTML", "CSS", "JS"); 
document.write(courses[10]); // courses 中只有 0，1，2 三个索引有元素值，courses[10] 为 undefined

content.text: 我们的 **courses** 数组只有3个元素，所以第10个索引，也就是第11个元素，并不存在（undefined）。
content.text_html:
Our **courses **array has just 3 elements, so the 10th index, which is the 11th element, does not exist (is undefined).

我们的课程数组只有3个元素，所以第10个索引，也就是第11个元素，并不存在（未定义）。

resolved.title: 数组菜单
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个数组`breakfasts`代表酒店早餐的菜单选项。

现在厨师决定用 "小面" 替换其中一个选项。

请编写一个程序，输入索引，用 "小面" 替换该索引的元素，并将新的菜单作为数组输出到控制台。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Arrays[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

The array you are given represents the menu of breakfast options available at the hotel.
The Chef decided to replace one of the options with "Fluffy Pancakes".
Write a program to take the index as input, replace the element with that index with "Fluffy Pancakes", and output the new menu to the console as an array.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
[
  'Cinnamon Doughnuts',
  'Waffles',
  'Fluffy Pancakes',
  'Chorizo Burrito',
  'French Toast'
]

The element with index 2 has been replaced in the output array.

[note]Remember that the [b]first element[/b] of an array has [b]0 index[/b].[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 请记住，数组中的**第一个元素**的索引是**0**。

testcases.explanation: 在输出数组中，索引为2的元素已被替换。
